cases.sentence: Спустя долгое время, на третьем году засухе, к Илии было слово ___.
cases.translation: After a long time, in the third year of the drought, Yahweh's word came to Elijah
cases.explain: In the phrase 'Yahweh's word', the genitive case is used.

cases.sentence: В Самаре был страшный голод, и Ахав призвал Авдия, распорядителя его ___.
cases.translation: There was severe famine in Samaria, and Ahab called Obadiah, who was over his household
cases.explain: The phrase 'steward of his household' uses genitive.

cases.sentence: Когда Иезавель истребляла господних пророков, Авдий взял сто пророков и спрятал их в двух ___, по пятьдесят в каждой.
cases.translation: When Jezebel was destroying Yahweh's prophets, Obadiah hid one hundred prophets in two caves, fifty in each
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location uses prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Иди по стране, ко всем источникам воды и рекам, может быть, мы сможем найти траву, чтобы прокормить лошадей и ___.
cases.translation: Go throughout the land to all the springs and streams; perhaps we can find grass to keep the horses and mules alive
cases.explain: The transitive verb прокормить (to feed) takes accusative.

cases.sentence: Авдий узнал его, поклонился до земли и сказал, 'Ты ли это, мой господин ___?'
cases.translation: Obadiah recognized him, fell on his face, and said, 'Is it you, my master Elijah?'
cases.explain: In direct address and appositives, the name takes nominative case.

cases.sentence: Они скакали вокруг сделанного ими ___. В полдень Илия начал насмехаться над ними.
cases.translation: They danced around the altar they had made. At noon Elijah began to mock them
cases.explain: The preposition around + genitive uses 'вокруг жертвенника'.

cases.sentence: Он разложил дрова, разрезал быка на части и положил его на ___. Затем он сказал.
cases.translation: He arranged the wood, cut the bull into pieces, and laid it on the wood
cases.explain: The preposition на (on/upon) with direction uses accusative.

cases.sentence: Тогда сошел огонь Господень и пожирал жертвы всесожжения, дрова, камни и почву, и поглотил воду во ___.
cases.translation: Then Yahweh's fire fell and consumed the offering, wood, stones, soil, and water in the trench
cases.explain: The preposition во (in) with location uses prepositional case.

reading.ru: Спустя долгое время, на третьем году засухе, к Илии было слово Господа. 'Иди и предстань перед Ахавом, и я пошлю на землю дождь.'
reading.question: What did God tell Elijah to do after three years of drought?
options: Go and show yourself to Ahab, and God would send rain on the land
reading.correct: Go and show yourself to Ahab, and God would send rain on the land
reading.explain: God commanded Elijah to go before Ahab and promised rain on the land.

reading.ru: Авдий был верным почитателем Господа. Когда Иезавель истребляла господних пророков, Авдий взял сто пророков и спрятал их в двух пещерах.
reading.question: Who was Obadiah and what did he do during Jezebel's persecution of prophets?
options: A devoted worshiper of the Lord who hid one hundred prophets in caves
A merchant who traded with other nations
reading.correct: A devoted worshiper of the Lord who hid one hundred prophets in caves
reading.explain: Obadiah was a faithful worshiper who risked his life hiding the prophets.

reading.ru: Из Господних пророков остался я один, а у Баала пророков 450 человек. Пусть нам приведут двух быков.
reading.question: What comparison did Elijah make between the prophets of God and the prophets of Baal?
options: He was the only prophet of God left, while Baal had 450 prophets
God had fewer prophets than Baal
reading.correct: He was the only prophet of God left, while Baal had 450 prophets
reading.explain: Elijah stated he was the sole prophet of God while Baal had 450.

reading.ru: Тогда сошел огонь Господень и пожирал жертвы всесожжения, дрова, камни и почву, и поглотил воду во рву.
reading.question: What happened when Elijah called upon the Lord during the contest on Mount Carmel?
options: Fire from the Lord fell and consumed the offering, wood, stones, soil, and water in the trench
Thunder and lightning struck the mountain
reading.correct: Fire from the Lord fell and consumed the offering, wood, stones, soil, and water in the trench
reading.explain: Fire from the Lord consumed everything, proving God's power.

reading.ru: Увидев это, весь народ пал ниц и закричал, 'Господь есть Бог! Господь есть Бог!'
reading.question: How did the people respond to the sign from God?
options: They fell down and declared 'The Lord is God!'
They demanded to see more signs
They accused Elijah of using magic
reading.correct: They fell down and declared 'The Lord is God!'
reading.explain: The people immediately declared their allegiance to the God of Israel.

reading.ru: Илья сказала Хаву, 'Иди, ешь и пей, потому что вот он, шум ливня'. И Ахав пошел есть и пить.
reading.question: What did Elijah tell Ahab after the fire fell from heaven?
options: Go eat and drink because there is the sound of heavy rain
reading.correct: Go eat and drink because there is the sound of heavy rain
reading.explain: Elijah told Ahab to eat and drink, saying he heard the sound of rain approaching.
